description:
ONE-TIME MANUAL STEP — performed by the human contributor (Chad / thewoolleyman)
via the GitHub UI + `gh secret set` CLI. Claude cannot perform App installation
on behalf of the user.

BACKGROUND
==========
The `livespec` GitHub App already exists and is installed on the `livespec`
repo (used by `auto-enable-merge.yml` and `auto-update-branches.yml`). It
has APP_ID + APP_PRIVATE_KEY secrets already configured at that repo level.

The cross-repo coordination automation surface requires the same App to be
installed on the other 3 sibling repos as well, with secrets propagated.

CURRENT STATE (verified as of session close)
============================================
Secrets per repo:
  - livespec:                 APP_ID + APP_PRIVATE_KEY present (from prior install)
  - livespec-dev-tooling:     NO secrets — needs install + secret set
  - livespec-runtime:         NO secrets — needs install + secret set
  - livespec-impl-plaintext:  NO secrets — needs install + secret set

GitHub topic livespec-sibling: present on all 4 repos (verified via Phase 4a).

Shim workflows: merged into all 4 repos pinned at livespec-dev-tooling@master:
  - livespec PR #224 (merged 2026-05-25T01:04:15Z)
  - livespec-dev-tooling PR #8 (merged 2026-05-25T01:05:13Z)
  - livespec-runtime PR #5 (merged 2026-05-25T01:04:46Z)
  - livespec-impl-plaintext PR #21 (merged 2026-05-25T01:04:49Z)

livespec-dev-tooling release v0.2.0 was cut (release-please PR #7 merged
2026-05-25T01:06:43Z); the reusable workflows are now consumable via
`livespec-dev-tooling/.github/workflows/reusable-*.yml@v0.2.0`.

STEP-BY-STEP INSTRUCTIONS
=========================

1. Navigate to the existing livespec GitHub App's settings page. The App
   is the one whose installation backs `auto-enable-merge.yml` in the
   livespec repo. Find it via either:

   a. GitHub UI: profile menu > Settings > Developer settings > GitHub Apps,
      look for the App that has the livespec scope.

   b. Or via the App's installation page on the livespec repo:
      https://github.com/thewoolleyman/livespec/settings/installations

2. From the App's settings page, verify it carries the following
   repository-level permissions (REQUIRED for the coordination surface
   per livespec-dev-tooling SPECIFICATION/contracts.md §"GitHub App auth model"):

     - contents: write       (to commit pin bumps + create branches)
     - pull-requests: write  (to open bump-pin PRs)
     - metadata: read        (for sibling discovery via topic query)

   If any of these are missing, edit the App's permissions to add them.
   GitHub will require existing installations to accept the new permissions
   on next use; this is a one-time prompt per installation.

3. Install the App on the 3 missing sibling repos:

     - thewoolleyman/livespec-dev-tooling
     - thewoolleyman/livespec-runtime
     - thewoolleyman/livespec-impl-plaintext

   From the App's installations page, click "Install" (or "Configure" if
   already partially installed), select the user thewoolleyman, then
   under "Repository access" choose "Only select repositories" and add
   the 3 repos above. Click Save.

4. Retrieve APP_ID and a fresh APP_PRIVATE_KEY:

     - APP_ID is shown on the App's "About" page. Note it down.

     - APP_PRIVATE_KEY: from the App's "Private keys" section, click
       "Generate a private key". A `.pem` file downloads. Copy its
       full contents (including the
       `-----BEGIN/END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----` lines).

5. Set the secrets on each of the 3 sibling repos via `gh secret set`:

     # Verify gh is authenticated with the right account
     gh auth status

     # Set APP_ID (same value across all 3 repos)
     echo "<APP_ID>" | gh secret set APP_ID -R thewoolleyman/livespec-dev-tooling
     echo "<APP_ID>" | gh secret set APP_ID -R thewoolleyman/livespec-runtime
     echo "<APP_ID>" | gh secret set APP_ID -R thewoolleyman/livespec-impl-plaintext

     # Set APP_PRIVATE_KEY (paste the full PEM content via stdin)
     gh secret set APP_PRIVATE_KEY -R thewoolleyman/livespec-dev-tooling < /path/to/private-key.pem
     gh secret set APP_PRIVATE_KEY -R thewoolleyman/livespec-runtime < /path/to/private-key.pem
     gh secret set APP_PRIVATE_KEY -R thewoolleyman/livespec-impl-plaintext < /path/to/private-key.pem

     # Verify each repo now has both secrets
     for r in livespec-dev-tooling livespec-runtime livespec-impl-plaintext; do
       echo "-- $r --"
       gh secret list -R thewoolleyman/$r
     done

6. After all 3 repos show APP_ID + APP_PRIVATE_KEY, this work-item is
   complete. The unblocks Phase 5b (smoke-test).

NEXT STEPS (Phase 5b, separate work-item li-tal73i)
===================================================
With the secrets in place, the smoke-test is:

  - Manually trigger pin-freshness on one sibling (Actions tab >
    "Pin freshness sweep" > Run workflow on master), OR
  - Tag a no-op patch release (e.g., livespec-runtime v0.2.1 from a
    chore:-only commit) and observe the release-dispatch fan-out.

Expected outcome:
  - dispatch fires from the source sibling
  - bump-pin PRs auto-open in the dependent siblings (via the App token)
  - CI passes
  - auto-merge lands the PRs

Document the verification trace in the work-item's closure narration.
title: Bootstrap GitHub App for cross-repo dispatch + record secrets
